image._help: manual = the studio writes prompts to art/prompts/ and you paste them into ANY image generator, then save files where TODO.md says. command = a shell command with {prompt_file} and {out}, e.g. your own generator CLI. Never put API keys here.

voice._help: Default VO department = Fish Audio Drama 3. Until enabled is true (and FISH_API_KEY is set in .env), the game uses the free placeholder voice and nothing calls the API.

llm._help: offline = no LLM at runtime; suspects speak authored lines (fully playable, free). live = free-text suspects via an LLM key you supply.

blender._help: PRO: local Blender scenes/props. Off on the free path.

runpod._help: PRO: final Cycles renders on a rented GPU. Every run has a price ceiling, a watchdog and auto-terminate.

pro._help: If true, heavy local work waits while the recorder process is running.
